correctness.rationale: Zero-diagonal nonnegative min-plus idempotency is exactly six directed triangle inequalities. For three labeled points the conditions x_ij≤x_ik+x_kj plus 0≤x_ij≤m yield one six-dimensional rational polytope with 18 inequalities. Independent exact active-set enumeration of all C(18,6)=18564 bases yielded 4704 nonsingular candidates and 31 feasible vertices, 29 integral and 2 half-integral. Independent fourfold interval summation gave 14 parity interpolation counts from m=0..13 and direct 6D enumeration agreed for m≤3. Rational Ehrhart theorem bounds degree six and period dividing two, so seven samples per parity prove both polynomials for all m; nonzero branch difference 1/32 proves minimal period two. The bounded m-slice is not closed under products, and zero off-diagonal values are allowed. Actual pinned verify.py was read; independent counts were computed separately, not accepted from its print line.
